annotations.title: Remove a pitch from your saved pitches

description: Remove one startup pitch (by pitch_id) from the investor's PitchSpark saved pitches, the list that pitchspark_watch_pitch_v1 adds to and pitchspark_list_watchlist_v1 reads. Use when: the investor asks to unsave, unwatch or drop a pitch from their saved pitches. Do not use for: finding startups (pitchspark_search_pitches_v3), saving a pitch (pitchspark_watch_pitch_v1), passing on a deal or moving it in the pipeline (done on pitchspark.io), contacting founders. Only the key owner's own saved row is removed and the founders are not told. A pitch that is also in the investor's active deal pipeline stays saved (status "in_pipeline"): manage it on pitchspark.io. Removing a pitch that is not saved changes nothing (status "not_watching"). Requires a PitchSpark API key (psk_...) from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation), or where OAuth is enabled a token for one with the watchlist:write scope. Uses none of the daily pitch allowance. Returns {"status" (removed, not_watching or in_pipeline), "pitch_id", "next_steps"}.

pitch_id.description: The "id" of a search, details or watchlist result, copied exactly.

name: pitchspark_unwatch_pitch_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

title: Investors: remove a startup pitch from your PitchSpark saved pitches
